thread:
zoe: Heads up — ACME (prod) opened a high-sev ticket: repeated 504s and ~30s timeouts to hosted inference endpoints. Ticket #7654. I can repro occasional 5xx from the gateway.

support-luis: Thanks. Gateway trace id acme-2026-04-14-01. Customer saw spikes ~11:20-11:35 PST and says it9s our hosted API (not client).

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-20260414-002. Paging oncall.

alyssa: I9m oncall. Can you give a minimal curl to reproduce?

support-luis: Repro curl:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd/large-x","input":"hello"}'
```
Sometimes returns `504 Gateway Timeout` ~30s.

marco: Gateway logs show downstream `503`/`504` from the inference pool during the window. Also seeing `upstream connect error or disconnect` spikes.

ben: Can you dump HPA/KEDA events for that namespace? Sounds like autoscale misbehavior.

marco: Extracts:
```
$ kubectl get hpa -n inference
NAME               REFERENCE                 TARGETS         MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS  AGE
rwd-inference      Deployment/rwd-inference  20%/80%         0         50        0         3d

$ kubectl describe scaledobject rwd-inference-scaledobj -n inference
ScaledObject rwd-inference-scaledobj:
  Triggers:
   type: prometheus
   metricName: rwd_queue_length
   threshold: 50
   cooldownPeriod: 300
   pollingInterval: 30
```

marco: HPA shows MINPODS=0 and current REPLICAS=0 during the incident window. KEDA using prometheus trigger with high threshold and long polling interval.

alyssa: MINPODS=0 explains cold starts. Our GPU model containers + warmup can be 20-45s. If nodes need to be provisioned too it gets worse. That explains the ~30s 504s.

miguel: Checked cloud node autoscaler: GPU node pool scale-up events were ~4 minutes. So requests hit a double cold-start: node provisioning + pod image pull + model init.

zoe: Customer says bursty jobs enqueue sudden spikes. KEDA config (30s poll, threshold 50) won9t catch short bursts.

ben: KEDA config is too sluggish for bursty traffic. Also HPA min 0 removes warm pods. Readiness probe could also delay traffic allocation.

alyssa: Check readiness probe. If it blocks until model/warmup done, pod is NotReady and won9t accept traffic even if Running.

marco: Deploy readiness probe: HTTP /health returns 200 only after model load and KV warmup. initialDelaySeconds=10, periodSeconds=10. Model load ~25-35s so NotReady during that time.

support-luis: Customer impact is high; AM asking for ETA. Need mitigation ASAP.

alyssa: Immediate mitigations:
- manually scale deployment to baseline (replicas=2)
- change KEDA pollingInterval (temporarily) and lower activation threshold
- consider loosening readinessProbe (high risk)

ben: Scaling now: `kubectl scale deploy rwd-inference --replicas=2 -n inference`.

ops-bot: kubectl scale command completed. New replicas requested: 2.

marco: One pod stuck `ContainerCreating` due to image pull rate limit on the registry — we hit pull throttling on GPU nodes. Other pod started after ~45s and readiness ~28s. Still seeing a few lingering 504s as the pool drains.

alyssa: Two issues: minReplicaCount=0 + registry/image pull delays + node scale time.

ben: Proposed KEDA/ScaledObject changes: `minReplicaCount: 1`, `pollingInterval: 5`, `cooldownPeriod: 60`, lower activation threshold (eg 5). Also set HPA min replicas accordingly.

miguel: I9ll PR those changes and add `imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent` plus a pre-puller DaemonSet to cache GPU images. Also suggest a small baseline node reservation in the pool for critical prod.

zoe: Told customer we set baseline replicas to avoid more 504s, investigating autoscale config + node/image cold starts. Offered 2-3hr ETA for root cause + follow-up.

support-luis: Customer accepted temporary fix but requested written postmortem and SLA credit review.

ben: Postmortem checklist items:
- why MIN_REPLICAS=0 allowed for critical prod workloads (defaults/docs?)
- KEDA default pollingInterval too slow for bursty workloads; update docs and defaults
- node/image cold start impacts (cloud provider scale time + registry throttling)
- add synthetic warmup traffic for dedicated pools to keep at least one warm instance
- alerting: create `endpoints_unavailable` alert (podReadyCount threshold) to catch this earlier

marco: Logs from window:
```
gateway: upstream connect error or disconnect while reading response header from upstream
inference-pool: Pod rwd-inference-0 NotReady (readiness probe failed) - model load 32s
keda-operator: ScaledObject rwd-inference-scaledobj metric rwd_queue_length=12 at 11:21:07
```

alyssa: Action items (owners):
- miguel: PR to set `minReplicaCount=1` and `pollingInterval=5s` (emergency branch)
- ben: run pre-puller DaemonSet and ensure images cached on GPU nodes
- marco: add temp alert rule and auto-bump replicas if gateway 504 spike > 5m
- zoe/support-luis: customer comms and credit convo

miguel: PR applied to staging, rolling to prod after smoke tests.

ops-bot: Deploy pipeline: rwd-infra -> apply ScaledObject patch -> success.

marco: After the patch, synthetic burst tests scale within ~10s and baseline replica prevents 504s. No new customer-visible 504s in last 20m.

zoe: Customer reports improved behavior, will wait for postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260414-002 resolved (mitigation applied). Please file postmortem within 72h.

ben: Early RCA: root cause = combination of MIN_REPLICAS=0 + KEDA pollingInterval too long for bursty enqueue patterns + node/image cold starts amplifying delay. Mitigations: baseline replicas, pre-pull images, adjust KEDA/HPA defaults, synthetic warmup traffic.

zoe: Closing loop with customer and summarizing planned fixes. Thanks team :thumbsup:
